requiredExecutorRules: Use separate runtime and Helm receipts. Initialize every phase NOT_EXECUTED, record actual argv/cwd/PID/time/exitCode, exact output root and binary hashes. Never mark an unreached phase PASS.

Verify new files and known unchanged test/helper/module hashes before use. Capture source HEAD, actual changed paths against the baseline and input/final SHA inventories for that invocation; no source archives or hardcoded productionChanged:false.

Compile failures, missing cached inputs and fixture failures are prerequisites, not product RED. Do not run a phase whose binary prerequisites failed. Runtime and Helm RED collection are independent; a genuine runtime RED need not suppress the Helm phases.

Hash the freshly compiled tagged harness and actual main, then recheck both immediately before execution. Execute that harness, not a differently rebuilt test or old worker-child executable. No historical migration build is required.

Bound each phase output to 2 MiB, capture stdout/stderr without exposing raw private values, and preserve only redacted logs. Redact runtime DB/password/S3 credentials and encoded variants; generated callbacks are checked by existing rememberTeamsURL/private checks, and raw child log buffers or signed URLs must not be serialized.

On timeout/failure, inspect this invocation's *-process-*.json records. Stop only exact owned PIDs after matching binary path, recorded main hash and process-start interval, following the existing Jira runner's identity rules. Never kill by process name. Report refused/orphan cleanup and output timeout as failure, not green.
Observe final child cleanup and file/input integrity before completing receipts. A retry gets entirely new output/cache roots. Do not repair shared services, certificates or trust stores.

Do not run old UI145/Jira/Teams backend/runtime/Helm corpora, migration builds, Quadlet generator, images, browsers, account flows or cluster operations in this author/initial-RED slice. Later preservation selectors require Sol/parent authorization.
